mapper.sql: r.id, r.rule_code, r.name, r.app_scenario, r.app_code, a.id AS app_id, a.name AS app_name, r.username, ur.real_name AS user_real_name, r.consumer_code, c.name AS consumer_name, r.logical_model_code, lm.model_name AS logical_model_name, r.retry_policy, r.ejection_policy, r.selection_strategy, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select:
select from kb_routing_rules r left join kb_apps a on r.app_code = a.app_code left join ks_users ur on r.username = ur.username and ur.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_routing_consumers c on r.consumer_code = c.consumer_code left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = r.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0
and ( r.rule_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.app_scenario like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by r.id desc

select from kb_routing_rules r left join kb_apps a on r.app_code = a.app_code left join ks_users ur on r.username = ur.username and ur.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_routing_consumers c on r.consumer_code = c.consumer_code left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = r.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0 where r.id = #{id}

select from kb_routing_rules r left join kb_apps a on r.app_code = a.app_code left join ks_users ur on r.username = ur.username and ur.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_routing_consumers c on r.consumer_code = c.consumer_code left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = r.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0 where r.consumer_code = #{consumerCode} and r.rule_code = #{ruleCode} and r.status = 1 limit 1

select from kb_routing_rules r left join kb_apps a on r.app_code = a.app_code left join ks_users ur on r.username = ur.username and ur.is_deleted = 0 left join kb_routing_consumers c on r.consumer_code = c.consumer_code left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = r.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0 where r.rule_code = #{ruleCode} limit 1
select count(1) from kb_routing_rules where app_code = #{appCode}
select count(1) from kb_routing_rules where username = #{username}
select count(1) from kb_routing_rules where logical_model_code = #{logicalModelCode}
select count(1) from kb_routing_rule_targets where rule_code = #{ruleCode}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_routing_rules(rule_code, name, app_scenario, app_code, username, consumer_code, logical_model_code, retry_policy, ejection_policy, selection_strategy, status) values(#{ruleCode}, #{name}, #{appScenario}, #{appCode}, #{username}, #{consumerCode}, #{logicalModelCode}, #{retryPolicy}, #{ejectionPolicy}, #{selectionStrategy}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_routing_rules set rule_code = #{ruleCode}, name = #{name}, app_scenario = #{appScenario}, app_code = #{appCode}, username = #{username}, consumer_code = #{consumerCode}, logical_model_code = #{logicalModelCode}, retry_policy = #{retryPolicy}, ejection_policy = #{ejectionPolicy}, selection_strategy = #{selectionStrategy}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
